violated_contract: When a pipeline fans one accepted payload out to typed persistence and raw background work, generated identity defaults must be materialized before the fanout. A model constructor that generates an ID only on its own copy leaves the raw branch without the identity required by downstream events, so valid processing fails during publication.
canonical_prevention: Materialize missing identity once at the shared admission boundary, preserve provided identities, and reuse the same normalized payload for persistence, capture-window keys, background matching, and event emission. A real-path regression must exercise an ID-less provider payload through raw background work and the real event model, not a stubbed emitter.
